performance_scope: Batch1 eight short development prompts, greedy, dynamic KV cache. Per-case untimed two-token warmup. Timing excludes load/tokenization/logit copies; reports first token separately.
reserved_memory_note: Allocator cache is released at round boundaries, then the same per-case two-token warmup is applied. Allocation peaks include the same packed model.

release_context.weight_status: Unpublished 96-update candidate. Public qat-step32 weights were not used in this measurement.
release_context.purpose: Numerical equivalence and bounded short-prompt inference timing; not quality acceptance.
release_context.implementation: Direct base3 decode, selected-row embedding decode and fused signed block-1024 Hadamard. Linear layers still decode to BF16 then use torch.nn.functional.linear.

measurement_details.warmup: Per case, up to two generated tokens outside the timed run; EOS can stop warmup earlier.
measurement_details.first_token: Includes prompt prefill; reported separately from the post-first-token rate.
measurement_details.pooled_rate_formula: sum(generated_token_count - 1) / sum(step_seconds[1:]) over eight prompts; not the mean of per-prompt rates.
measurement_details.EOS: Generation stops at EOS. An emitted EOS token is counted. English quantization reached the 32-token limit without EOS.
measurement_details.memory: PyTorch max allocated and reserved include the packed model; allocator cache released between rounds. These are not whole-card NVML usage.
measurement_details.comparison: Same 96-update packed manifest, tokenizer, prompt token IDs, greedy generation and KV caching in all four rounds.

semantic_review.scope: Manual reading of eight previously used development prompts; no capability score or unseen evaluation.
semantic_review.conclusion: The acceleration preserved these outputs, including their existing errors. It did not establish quality recovery.

cases.reason: Defines quantization as predicting business metrics under conditions; the concept is wrong.
Mentions fewer bits and lower memory, but answers a Chinese prompt in English and refers to features rather than model weights.
Answers only Beijing and ends with EOS.
Answers only OK and ends with EOS.
Connects reduced weight precision to memory reduction; reaches the 32-token cap without EOS.
Translates Good morning to Chinese and ends with EOS.

provenance.entry_status: Portable wrapper around the recorded numerical kernels. Its own GPU verification is recorded separately; this evidence is from the original frozen benchmark driver.
provenance.privacy: Raw host identifiers, resource logs, credentials, private paths and launch plans omitted. Original model summary fields retained verbatim.
